messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page triggered: PAGER-1123 — high 5xx rate observed for private-eu-inference pool (satellite-eu-1). Auto-escalate: oncall-eu -> pagerduty.
pagerduty: PAGER-1123 fired at 2025-11-02T14:10:56Z. Responders: @alex, @marta, @oncall-eu.
alex: ack — I'm taking first pass. looking at logs and rate metrics.
sophie: thx alex, i'm standing by if you need traffic cuts or an infra rollback.
alex: error spike coincides with a canary deploy of model v2.8.3 -> increased decoder op failures. seeing many "CUDA OOM"-style kernel falls and 502s into router.
marta: switching to me now — handoff in 1m. alex, paste links to the failing pod logs?
alex: logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/stream?query=PAGER-1123 (filtered). sample: 
```
E 14:09:42 inference-serving: decode_kernel_failed: status=12, mem=free:2.1Gi total:24Gi
W 14:09:43 http: upstream returned 502 for request id=abc123
```
deepak: adding context — private-eu uses older driver on some hosts; v2.8.3 introduced a tiled-attention kernel that regresses memory on those drivers.
marta: plan: 1) revert canary -> v2.8.2 2) scale up warm instances of v2.8.2 for traffic 3) enable prefix-KV cache to reduce decoder load 4) customer-facing PSA if impact persists. anyone object?
sophie: +1 on revert. can help with rollout commands.
alex: starting revert now: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-eu-canary --to-revision=2`
incident-bot: Deploy webhook: rollback job started by alex at 2025-11-02T14:12:30Z.
marta: I've asked autoscaler to add 4 warm nodes in eu cluster (request sent). routing team to shift 30% traffic off canary to stable via weight tweak.
pagerduty: PAGER-1123 acknowledged by marta at 2025-11-02T14:13:05Z.
alex: rollback progress: canary pods terminating, stable pods spiking healthy. no new 502s in last 40s on the canary group.
deepak: filing a follow-up to test tiled-attention on older driver images; assigning to eng-runtime team.
sophie: customer impact note: initial spike caused ~0.7% global request error rate over 6 minutes; support reported 3 customers with visible errors (AcmeCorp, BrightAPI, Lumen.ai). I'm prepping a brief for CS.
marta: customer comms draft: "We experienced elevated inference errors in EU private pool due to a canary model rollout; we've reverted the canary and traffic is stable. We'll follow up with root cause and ETA for safe re-rollout." anyone want to edit?
alex: that's good. add that we don't believe data was exposed.
sophie: also add that queued requests were retried automatically; recommend telling customers retries were attempted.
marta: rolling update complete. Verified 200s across the board for 5m. Monitoring for regression for 30m then will close page.
incident-bot: PAGER-1123 status: mitigated by rollback at 2025-11-02T14:15:26Z. Alert suppressed for 30m.
pagerduty: PAGER-1123 resolved by marta at 2025-11-02T14:15:40Z.
deepak: created ticket RUNTIME-789 to track kernel regression and driver compatibility tests.
sophie: CS notified. I'll sync with AcmeCorp support rep in case they want more details.
marta: thanks team. postmortem owner: deepak. I'll help with timeline. leaving this thread open for final notes. :thumbsup:
alex: dropping off — ping if anything else.
sophie: standing down but will watch customer replies.
incident-bot: Note: oncall escalation reset, no further pages for private-eu-inference in last 10m.
